title: Inhibition of BET recruitment to chromatin as an effective treatment for MLL-fusion leukaemia
central_claims: Displacing BET proteins from chromatin selectively inhibits MLL-fusion leukemia cells and BCL2 expression.
I-BET151 provides survival benefit in mouse leukemia models and has therapeutic potential.

source_manifest.title: Replication Study: Inhibition of BET recruitment to chromatin as an effective treatment for MLL-fusion leukaemia
source_manifest.finding: Selective MV4;11 inhibition and BCL2 reduction replicated; xenograft survival difference was not significant with conditioning and dose differences.

source_manifest.title: BET inhibitor OTX015 targets BRD2 and BRD4 and decreases c-MYC in acute leukemia cells
source_manifest.finding: Independent BET-inhibitor work in leukemia cell lines and patient samples found growth arrest and apoptosis with OTX015/JQ1.
